name: Phantom Mansion Chapter 6: The Indigo Dungeon
summary:
Hector is nearing the end of his quest to clear Prospero's Abbey from the curse of the Red Death. In the Indigo Dungeon he encounters a devious dwarf jester by the name of Hop-Frog. He loves gold and will steal keys from Hector.
Chase Hop-Frog through the dungeons avoiding the Skeletons and Zombies. Rescue the tormented souls and dispel the curse of the Red Death.
